segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, yeah, this is Dan with Northview Logistics. I need to add 6 seats to our account for the operations team, ideally today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I confirm the account is Northview Logistics on the Growth plan, billing admin email dan.reed@northviewlogistics.com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s me. We’re at 42 seats right now and need to go to 48.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m in the billing tool now. The additional 6 seats will be prorated through your current term ending September 30, and the prorated charge is $684.12 before tax. Is it okay to apply that to the card ending in 4418?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that’s fine. And the users can be provisioned right away once the seats are added?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. Once I submit this, the seat count updates immediately in the admin console. Your admins can invite the new users after that.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: All set. Your account now shows 48 seats, and I’ve generated invoice 28764 for the prorated amount. You should receive the receipt by email in a few minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, I see the seats in the admin console already. That’s all I needed.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Glad to hear it. I’ll close ticket 514209 as resolved. Thanks for calling, Dan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks, Maya. Have a good one.
